plan.about: The cash audit plan the Fast Finance Audit Machine follows for the invented HANGS Construction Development LP. The runner reads its rates, the stale-check age and the words that mark a bank charge from here; the Confirmations system shows it. Every name and figure is invented.

materiality.why: The same materiality as the year-end audit: book income is what the partners and a lender watch for a profit-making homebuilder. The engagement partner sets the final amounts.

cash.assertions: Existence and completeness of cash at June 30, 2026, its cut-off, and whether any of it is restricted or needs to be disclosed.
cash.subsequentPeriod: Every reconciling item is traced to the July 2026 statement or explained by the bank in writing.

procedures.what: Recompute cash from every ledger line, agree it to the trial balance, the statements and the client's reconciliation, and propose materiality.
Send the confirmation with the client's authorization, receive the bank's answers directly, and compare the confirmed balance with the books.
Agree the confirmed balance to the June statement and the reconciliation, match every June payment to the statement, and recompute the reconciliation.
Trace every reconciling item to the July statement or the bank's written answer, age the old checks and search the books for bank charges.
Test the wires and transfers either side of June 30, the last receipts, and whether any cash is held back, pledged or restricted.
Set what was found against materiality, propose the adjustments and write the workpapers and the findings memo. The CPA concludes.
